name: Ciriaco Bardales — an earlier partner, Carmen Morales, and an infant son who died in 1905
researcher_question: Before his marriage to Clara Amelia Palacios Oliva, did Ciriaco Bardales have a son by a Carmen Morales — an infant Ciriaco who died 12 August 1905 in Guatemala City?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-2.csv row 14, hint-samples.csv row 422, flags adds_spouse/adds_son, confidence 3). NOT RESOLVED — adjudication attempted and left open; the findings below are the hint's claim, not confirmed ground truth. The father is identified only by the register's origin field, and four registers split two against two: the 1896 birth (ark:/61903/1:1:6K2Q-S4B2) and 1896 death (ark:/61903/1:1:Z95C-JY6Z) of an earlier son of the same couple both say "originarios y vecinos de esta ciudad" (capital-born), while the 1905 birth (ark:/61903/1:1:6KNJ-27P8) and death (ark:/61903/1:1:6D38-BQ8L) of the hint's infant say Chiquimula — matching the tree person (b. Quezaltepeque, Chiquimula; ark:/61903/1:1:Z9YP-SKN2 gives "originario de Esquipulas"). A boilerplate explanation of the 1896 pair was tested against the facing page and refuted. Needs the mandatory second opinion before it can ship. See README "The unresolved tension".
